observations.title: Customize advancement notifications
observations.player_action: Choose a toast texture/animation and configure title, description, anchor and audio settings.
observations.outcome: Existing advancement announcements use the selected presentation; advancement criteria are unchanged.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Load a custom toast texture
observations.player_action: Place matching texture/data assets in config/fancytoasts/textures and reopen the configuration menu.
observations.outcome: Matching PNG/JSON names and a 256x256 PNG are required; the menu refreshes available textures without restarting the game.
conditions: Texture/data format must match installed 1.5.1; no asset was created or installed in this research task.
